relation.evidence_text: Medusa is a ransomware-as-a-service (RaaS) variant first identified in June 2021.
Medusa developers and affiliates have impacted over 300 victims from a variety of critical infrastructure sectors

The Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI), Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA), and the Multi-State Information Sharing and Analysis Center (MS-ISAC) are releasing this joint advisory to disseminate known Medusa ransomware TTPs and IOCs
